sn22.157:1.2: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kiṃ upādāya kiṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhāti.
sn22.157:1.4: rūpe kho bhikkhave sati rūpaṃ upādāya rūpaṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhā.
sn22.157:1.8: viññāṇe sati viññāṇaṃ upādāya viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa uppajjanti saññojanābhinivesavinibandhā.
sn22.157:1.13: api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyyuṃ saññojanābhinivesavinibandhāti.
sn22.157:1.14: no hetaṃ bhante. vedanā …pe… saññā. saṅkhārā. viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti. aniccaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti. dukkhaṃ bhante. yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhuṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyyuṃ saññojanābhinivesavinibandhāti. no hetaṃ bhante.
